name: Kosaka Shouko
source:
A nurse at the hospital where the protagonist is admitted.

Although their relationship lasted only six months, she was his former girlfriend before he started dating Ai.

They first met at a group dating party (gōkon) organized between Seiji's vocational school friends and students from the nursing school Shoko was attending at the time.

The two hit it off and began dating, but after approximately six months, Shoko's infidelity came to light, and they broke up.

She is sexually open-minded and the type of person who easily gives in to physical pleasure.

Perhaps as a reaction to working in a profession that constantly deals with life and death, she sometimes acts impulsively and lives in the moment without thinking too deeply about the consequences.

In fact, she still has feelings for the protagonist even now.

Seeing how completely devoted he is to Ai makes her feel a little jealous, and she repeatedly finds excuses to approach him and get involved in his affairs.

[Translated from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/1446]the official site[/url]]
